records.text:
Stop Dribbling After You Pee (The S-Bend Method That Actually Works)

Dribbling after you pee is extremely common in men over 50, and it’s usually not dangerous. Learn why it happens (urine trapped in the natural S-shaped curve of the urethra), the 10-second “S-Bend Method” quick fix, and the pelvic floor exercises that helped 75% of men in one clinical trial stop dribbling completely.


💬 Type “me too” if this happens to you. You’re not alone.

📚 Sources:
• Paterson J, Pinnock CB, Marshall VR. Pelvic floor exercises as a treatment for post-micturition dribble. Br J Urol. 1997;79(6):892–897.
• Dorey G et al. Pelvic floor exercises for treating post-micturition dribble in men with erectile dysfunction: a randomized controlled trial. Urol Nurs. 2004;24(6):490–497. https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15658...
• Dorey G. Prevalence, aetiology and treatment of post-micturition dribble in men: literature review. Physiotherapy. 2002;88(4):225–234.
• Albakr A et al. Management of post-micturition dribble in men: systematic review and meta-analysis (ICS-EUS 2025).

⚠️ Educational content only, not medical advice. See your doctor if you have a weak stream, pain, blood in your urine, or trouble urinating.

#MensHealth #ProstateHealth #PelvicFloor #Over50 #BladderHealth

doctor. So, let me tell you three things

type me too in the comments. [music] No
details needed. You'll see just how
common this really is. So, why does this
happen? To understand the fix, you need
to understand the plumbing. In men, the
tube that carries urine out of the
bladder, called the urethra, isn't the
straight pipe. It's long and it has a
natural curve, a bit like an S. And part
of that curve, deep underneath, behind
the scrotum, sits lower than the rest.
Think of the S-bend pipe under your
kitchen sink. After the water stops
running, a little bit always stays
trapped in that low curve. The same
thing happens in your body. When you
finish urinating, a small amount of
urine stays trapped in that low part of
the curve. Now, here's the important
part. When you're younger, a muscle at
the base of your pelvis called the bulbo
cavernosis muscle automatically squeezes
at the end of urination. It works like a
hand squeezing the last bit of
toothpaste out of a tube. It pushes that
trapped urine out before you zip up. But
as we get older, that muscle can get
weaker. It can also be affected by an
enlarged prostate. prostate surgery,
weight gain, diabetes, or long periods
of sitting, so the squeeze isn't strong
enough anymore. The urine stays trapped
in the Sbend, and when you stand up
straight and start walking, it trickles
out. Doctors call this postmurition
dribble. Post means after, and mixtur

after you urinate. And here's what

reach the S-bend because the trapped
urine is further back behind the
scrotum. If you're finding this helpful

know you're still with me. Now, here's
what the research says actually works.
In a study published in 1997 in the
British Journal of Urology, researchers
[music] in Australia took 49 men aged 36
to 83 who had this exact problem. They
split them into three groups. One group

technique to clear the Sben by hand
called urethal milking and one group did
daily pelvic floor exercises. After 12
weeks, the advice only group didn't
improve at all. Both the hand technique
and the exercises helped and the
exercises helped the most. Then in 2004,
a researcher in England named Grace Dory
tested pelvic [music] floor exercises
plus a strong squeeze at the end of
urinating in a randomized trial of men
with erection problems. [music]
About two out of three of those men also
had post urination dribbling. After
three months of supervised exercises and
three more months of exercising at home,
75% of the men with dribbling became
completely free of it. So, the Sbend
method combines both of these. The quick
fix you can use today and the long-term
fix that strengthens the muscle so the
[music] problem can fade away. Part one,
the quick fix, which you can use

muscles at the base of your pelvis.
Firmly, the same muscles you'd use to
stop yourself from passing gas or hold

twice. This is the squeeze out that was

the Sbend sweep. Now place two or three
